packageName.description: npm package name. Default: derived from package.json `name`.

packagePath.description: Path to the package directory containing package.json. Default: project root.

releaseVersion.description: Version to release (x.y.z, or patch|minor|major vs npm latest). Default: "patch".

dryRun.description: If true, do not commit, tag, or push. Default: false.

branch.description: Branch to push the bump commit to. Default: "main".

generateNotes.description: If true, create a GitHub Release with auto-generated changelog. Default: true.

provenance.description: If true, publish with --provenance (npm OIDC). Default: true.
